reviews.text:
Excellent service, 10/10.
I requested training for my dog, an Old English Sheepdog (a bit stubborn, by the way), and it worked perfectly at home.
We also hired their doggy daycare service two days a week, and it's been great too. My dog ​​gets to play with her friends, they go on safe trails, and there are only a few dogs per trainer. Highly recommended! 😉👌🏼

My pet is a Belgian Shepherd puppy named Bella. At just a few months old, she was already a challenge for me because she belongs to a very energetic and dominant breed. So I sought help from Dog Training Academy, where Bella received proper training. Now she can socialize and interact with people and animals without posing a threat. She has also been attending their daycare regularly for the past two years, where she exercises, plays, and socializes in a safe environment. I highly recommend Dog Training Academy because they carry out their services with great responsibility, professionalism, and affection for my pet, who holds a very important place in our lives. Thanks to their director and trainer, Alex, and to his entire team for their dedication and care of Bella.
My Luka 🐶 loves his walks in the mountains and Alex is a great trainer. We highly recommend him. …

Excellent service! The staff is always kind and attentive to both owners and puppies. The school helped little Rabbit socialize and manage his reactivity, and he loves the daycare too; he comes home happy and exhausted from playing so much!
Highly recommended!

Excellent service. They are always respectful and treat pets well. They also offer services and packages that are hard to find at other training schools. My dog ​​shows signs of enjoying his time at Dog Training Academy every time I take him.

We really enjoyed the classes with Alex; from the beginning, he explains things and asks about the goals you want to achieve with your dog. In addition to the daycare and hiking training, we as owners also have homework to practice what we've learned, which I think is a great complement. Even though we finished our training, we decided to continue sending our dog hiking; it makes him very happy and helps him socialize with other dogs.
Great experience!! The classes were fantastic!! Highly recommended

I highly recommend it. Personally, I found everything very professional, and they have techniques for different types of dogs. Improvement is noticeable from the very first class. They also offer classes specifically for our dogs as well as for us as owners.
